_meta.source: Three-tier holdout program per CLAUDE.md rule 22 and docs/handoffs/holdout-policy-memo-2026-07.md, as enforced by scripts/run_calibration_full.py (enforce_holdout_year_gate) and the CI quarantine-gates job. Tier assignments are the program's real design; 'scored' flags are program-level illustration (only NEISO has a calibration-complete marker and a scored one-shot as of 2026-07-11), NOT a per-ISO status feed.
_meta.description: Year-by-year tier timeline (2018-2030) for the model-validity narrative page. tier: data (intaken, never solved) | train (2023-2025, the only tuned years) | validation (2022, iterable) | locked (2019 + H1-2026, touch-once) | forecast (2026+ forward horizon, extends to END_YEAR 2050). flags carry secondary roles: 2024-2025 carry 'crossover-overlap-roadmap' - the dual-mode backcast/forecast crossover scoring is a labelled ROADMAP target, not implemented code (forecast START_YEAR is 2026; no dual-mode scorer exists).

tiers.data: Raw data intaken on disk (owner-authorized, no-LP validation only); never solved or scored.
tiers.train: Calibration window - the ONLY years tuned against; every keeper solves all three in one bundle.
tiers.validation: Iterable holdout - a miss may send you back to re-tune the train window; selection evidence, not certified skill.
tiers.locked: Touch-once test - scored exactly once per ISO with the frozen keeper config; no calibration change may respond to the result.
tiers.forecast: Forward horizon (constants.py START_YEAR 2026 to END_YEAR 2050); forecast mode uses no measured actuals.

years.note: Intake ladder floor; candidate for future validation-ladder extension.
Clean-regime locked test. Scored once only where a calibration-complete marker exists (NEISO, 2026-07); result stands, never re-enters tuning.
The iterable validation holdout; unlocked per-ISO by the calibration-complete marker.
Train year; also the first year of the ROADMAP 2024-2025 backcast/forecast crossover overlap (target design, not implemented).
Train year; second ROADMAP crossover-overlap year.

H1-2026 measured actuals are the forward-edge locked test (touch-once). Full-year 2026 is simultaneously the forecast horizon start - forecast-mode runs use no measured H1-2026 data and are unrestricted.
Forecast horizon continues to END_YEAR 2050; timeline truncated here for display.
